schema_rejection.prompt: Edit the attached existing game monster references into one production sprite atlas containing SIX separate neutral full-body enemy sprites on a truly transparent background. Keep the same finely pixelated dark-ink/soft-volume/old-brass fantasy game art family as the attached images, suitable for side-view platformer monsters displayed at 32–44 pixels tall. Large clear anatomy and color masses, substantially fewer tiny ornaments, no text, no numbers, no UI, no shadows/background, no auxiliary lines. Strict layout: 2 columns x 3 rows, equally sized 512x512 cells on 1024x1536 canvas; each complete creature centered in its own cell with ample transparent separation and all limbs intact. All creatures look RIGHT in consistent side or shallow three-quarter view, feet aligned near bottom of each cell. Row1 left: small alive-looking PATROL creature, plump warm grey-brown torso, distinct pale wheat head/chest to the right, two clearly separate dark brown legs, a few old copper joints, full simple silhouette. Row1 right: CHARGER based on attached boar-beetle reference, low wide heavy body, thick shoulder/front half, grey moss green shell, earth-brown front/back legs clearly distinguishable, prominent pale ivory forward horn, very few old copper armor fittings; low horizontal stocky profile, not upright. Row2 left: HOPPER, rounded pale olive green abdomen/back, pale wheat belly, very large thick dark-olive bent hind leg at left, tiny front legs at right clearly separated from hind legs, compact head facing right, elastic grasshopper/frog-insect hybrid preserving reference family. Row2 right: SEED SENTRY, rotund pale cream seed sac at left/center, grey-green large leaf plates, clearly projecting brown-copper hollow nozzle facing right from upper front, two substantial supporting legs, few decorations; nozzle and seed chamber distinct. Row3 left: FAN SENTRY hovering insect, OLD COPPER abdomen center/lower and two very broad grey-brown fan-shaped wings spreading horizontally upper left/right, pale wheat wing edges, broad blunt fan silhouette rather than a long dragonfly; keep wings spatially distinct from belly and legs with some transparent gaps, complete symmetrical fan spread. Row3 right: ROOT BELL plant creature, thick grey-green curved main stem, few large leaves, clearly visible enlarged warm light copper bell hanging toward upper right with pale gold bell mouth, dark brown stable root feet moderately splayed; simple clear stem/bell/root anatomy without twig noise. Do not add the diving insect: it remains unchanged as the benchmark. This atlas is neutral rig-ready art, no action poses. Each sprite should read at tiny game scale. Preserve visible pixel clusters and restrained highlights, avoid glossy smooth rendering or busy texture.
